rules: Adapters are an interface layer only.
source_application identifies origin. It never selects a pipeline.
No per-IA memory tables, writers, or CAPTURE forks.
ARIA never auto-approves memory. GATE humano remains mandatory.
Adding a new IA means registering a client against the existing MCP, not building a new brain.
